description: WRITE. Ask Geisel Power, the Virtuoso advisor, to price a stay at a Virtuoso hotel (property_id from search_trips). Virtuoso data carries no live rates, so pricing is asynchronous: this returns a quote id with status "pending" and a quote_due_by time (within 24 hours); poll get_availability_quote. A firm offer includes the full total, taxes and fees, the hotel's cancellation policy, and the Virtuoso amenities (e.g. breakfast for two, a hotel credit, an upgrade, subject to availability). Nothing is reserved or charged by this call, and hotel bookings carry no fee.
name: search_availability
title: Request a stay quote (Virtuoso perks)
